A batsman scored the following runs in the last 5 innings. Find his score in the 4th innings if the average score is 43. Innings Score (in runs)

1st - 92

2nd - 53

3rd - 35

4th - X

5th - 27
questions.solution:
**Formula Used:**

Average score = (Total score in all innings) / (Number of innings)

**Calculation:**

Let X be the score in the 4th innings.

Total score in all innings = 92 + 53 + 35 + X + 27

Number of innings = 5

Average score = 43

So, we have:

43 = (92 + 53 + 35 + X + 27) / 5

⇒ 43 × 5 = 92 + 53 + 35 + X + 27

⇒ 215 = 207 + X

⇒ X = 215 - 207

⇒ X = 8

**The score in the 4th innings is 8.**

questions.question: A man's average driving speed for 9 hours is 88 km/hr. During the first five hours of his journey, he drove at 74 km/hr, and last two hours he drove at 82 km/hr. What was his average speed (in km/hr) for the sixth and the seventh hour?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Overall **average speed** for 9 hr = 88 km/hr.

Net deviation for first 5 hr = 5 × (74 − 88) = −70 km.

Net deviation for last 2 hr = 2 × (82 − 88) = −12 km.

Total deficit = −70 − 12 = −82 km.

The 6th and 7th hr must compensate for this deficit: 88 + (82 ÷ 2) = 129 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 129 km/hr.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total **time** = 9 hr, Total **average speed** = 88 km/hr.

**Time segment 1** = 5 hr, **Speed** = 74 km/hr.

**Time segment 3** = 2 hr, **Speed** = 82 km/hr.

**Formula:** **Total Distance** = **Average Speed** × **Total Time**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0cd4d6d7565920a775a3604fd52ed2104d25f0fdd8800b007b550ff61be3f1c.png] 

⇒ **Total Distance** = 88 × 9 = 792 km

⇒ **Distance** in first 5 hr = 74 × 5 = 370 km

⇒ **Distance** in last 2 hr = 82 × 2 = 164 km

⇒ **Sum** of known distances = 370 + 164 = 534 km

⇒ **Remaining distance** (6th + 7th hr) = 792 − 534 = 258 km

⇒ **Average speed** for 6th and 7th hr = 258 ÷ 2 = 129 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 129 km/hr.**

**__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Equal Time Intervals

When time intervals are equal, the **Average Speed** is the **Arithmetic Mean** of the individual speeds: Vₐvg = (v₁ + v₂ + ... + vₙ) ÷ n.

Average Speed for Equal Distances

If two equal distances are covered at speeds 'a' and 'b', the **Average Speed** is the **Harmonic Mean**: 2ab ÷ (a + b).

Weighted Average Method

The overall average speed can be calculated using the **weighted average** formula: Vₐvg = (n₁v₁ + n₂v₂ + ...) ÷ (n₁ + n₂ + ...), where n represents the time spent at each speed.</p

questions.question: A cone of radius 16 cm and height 12 cm is cut, parallel to the base, at some height closer to the top. If the ratio of the heights of the solids is 1∶ 3, then the ratio of the total surface areas of the two solids formed is approximately given by:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the original cone (R) = 16 cm

Height of the original cone (H) = 12 cm

Ratio of the heights of the two solids (smaller cone : frustum) = 1 : 3

**Formula Used:**

Slant height of a cone (l) = sqrt{r² + h²}

Total surface area of a cone = π r (l + r)

Total surface area of a frustum = π (r₁ + r₂)l' + π r₁² + π r₂², where l' is the slant height of the frustum.

**Calculation:**

Height of the smaller cone (h) = (1)/(1+3) times 12 = (1)/(4) times 12 = 3 cm

Height of the frustum (H - h) = 12 - 3 = 9 cm

Using similar triangles for the radii: (r)/(h) = (R)/(H)

⇒ (r)/(3) = (16)/(12)

⇒ r = (16 times 3)/(12) = 4 cm (radius of the top of the frustum)

Slant height of the original cone (L) = sqrt{16² + 12²} = sqrt{256 + 144} = sqrt{400} = 20 cm

Slant height of the smaller cone (l) = sqrt{4² + 3²} = sqrt{16 + 9} = sqrt{25} = 5 cm

Slant height of the frustum (l') = L - l = 20 - 5 = 15 cm

Total surface area of the smaller cone (TSA₁) = π r (l + r) = π times 4 (5 + 4) = π times 4 times 9 = 36π cm²

Total surface area of the frustum (TSA₂) = π (r + R)l' + π r² + π R²

⇒ TSA₂ = π (4 + 16) times 15 + π (4)² + π (16)²

⇒ TSA₂ = π (20) times 15 + 16π + 256π

⇒ TSA₂ = 300π + 16π + 256π = 572π cm²

Ratio of the total surface areas = TSA₁ : TSA₂ = 36π : 572π 

⇒ Ratio = 36 : 572 = 9 : 143

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**

Sum of weights = Number of individuals × Average weight

Total number of boys and girls = nb + ng = 20 + 30 = 50

Total weight of all boys and girls = (nb + ng) × avgₐₗₗ = 50 × 54 = 2700 kg

questions.question: A policeman saw a thief at a distance of 800m. When the policeman started chasing the thief, the thief started running. If the ratio of the speeds of the policeman to the thief is 3:2, then the distance travelled by the policeman to catch the thief is
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the **time** of the chase is constant for both the policeman and the thief, **Distance** is directly proportional to **Speed**.

Ratio of Speeds (Policeman : Thief) = 3 : 2 ⇒ Ratio of Distances = 3 : 2.

Difference in distance units = 3 − 2 = 1 unit.

Given, 1 unit = 800 m.

Total distance traveled by the policeman = 3 units = 3 × 800 m = 2400 m = 2.4 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 2.4 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial distance between **Policeman** and **Thief** = 800 m.

Ratio of speed of **Policeman** (Vₚ) to **Thief** (Vₜ) = 3 : 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdb691dba8c88dbac5864efcaffbfbfe85b39b7911b5b449e7260c4d08a800bf.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the speed of the **policeman** be 3x and the speed of the **thief** be 2x.

⇒ Relative speed in same direction = 3x − 2x = x.

⇒ Time taken to catch the thief = Initial Distance ÷ Relative Speed

⇒ Time (T) = 800 ÷ x

⇒ Distance covered by the **policeman** = Speed of policeman × Time

⇒ Distance = 3x × (800 ÷ x)

⇒ Distance = 3 × 800 = 2400 m

⇒ Distance in km = 2400 ÷ 1000 = 2.4 km

**∴ The correct answer is 2.4 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concept

When two objects move in the **same direction**, the relative speed is the difference between their speeds: (u − v).

Distance and Speed Relation

When time is constant, the ratio of distances covered is **directly proportional** to the ratio of speeds (D₁/D₂ = S₁/S₂).

Unit Conversion

To convert **meters** to **kilometers**, divide the value by 1000 (1 km = 1000 m).</p

questions.question: The ratio of prices of coffee and tea is 5 : 7 and the ratio of their quantities consumed by a family is 7 : 9. Find the ratio of expenditures on coffee and tea.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of prices of coffee and tea = 5 : 7

Ratio of quantities consumed by a family = 7 : 9

Expenditure ratio = Price ratio × Quantity ratio

**Calculation:**

Let the price of coffee be 5x and the price of tea be 7x.

Let the quantity of coffee consumed be 7y and the quantity of tea consumed be 9y.

Expenditure on coffee = 5x × 7y = 35xy

⇒ 35 : 63

⇒ 5 : 9

**The ratio of expenditures on coffee and tea is 5 : 9.**

questions.question: A certain sum of money will be ₹10,800 in 5 years. If simple interest is two-third of the principal, then the rate of interest p.a. is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Future Value (A) = ₹10,800

Time (T) = 5 years

Simple interest (SI) = 2/3 of Principal (P)

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = P × R × T / 100

Future Value (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

**Calculation:**

Let the Principal be P.

Simple Interest (SI) = 2/3 × P

Future Value (A) = P + SI

⇒ 10,800 = P + (2/3)P

⇒ 10,800 = (3P + 2P) / 3

⇒ 10,800 = 5P / 3

⇒ P = 6,480

Simple Interest (SI) = 2/3 × 6,480 = 4,320

SI = P × R × T / 100

⇒ 4,320 = 6,480 × R × 5 / 100

⇒ 4,320 = 32,400R / 100

⇒ 4,320 = 324R

⇒ R = 4,320 / 324

⇒ R = 13(1)/(3)\%

**The rate of interest p.a. is 13(1)/(3)\%.**

questions.solution:

Breadth of the floor = 70 feet

**Formula Used:**

Area of the largest square workstation = (GCD of Length and Breadth)²

**Calculation:**

Length = 98 feet

Breadth = 70 feet

GCD of 98 and 70:

98 = 2 × 7 × 7

70 = 2 × 5 × 7

GCD (98, 70) = 2 × 7 = 14

Area of the largest square workstation = 14²

Area = 196 sq. ft

**The area of the largest workstation that can be allotted to any user is 196 sq. ft.**

• Examples of analgesic medicines include **paracetamol (acetaminophen), ibuprofen, and aspirin**.
 
• Some analgesics, such as **opioids**, are prescribed for more severe pain and must be used under medical supervision due to their potential for **addiction and side effects**.

 __
 
• Medicines for **correcting deficiencies** include **vitamin supplements and nutritional supplements**.
 
• These are used when there is a lack of essential nutrients in the body, leading to conditions like **scurvy (vitamin C deficiency) or rickets (vitamin D deficiency)**.

• Medicines that **kill or weaken microbes** are known as **antimicrobials**, which include **antibiotics, antivirals, antifungals, and antiparasitics**.

• The responsibility for maintaining land records and revenue collection typically falls under the purview of **state governments** and their respective **revenue departments**.
 
• The primary functions of the Supreme Court include:
 
 
• **Judicial Review**: It acts to check the powers of the executive and legislative branches and ensure laws are consistent with the Constitution.
 
• **Federal Equilibrium**: It ensures the balance of power between the central and state governments.
 
• **Protection of Fundamental Rights**: It acts as the guardian of the fundamental rights of citizens enshrined in the Constitution.

 __
 
• The Supreme Court has the power of **Judicial Review**, allowing it to invalidate laws and executive actions that violate the Constitution.
 
• This function ensures the **enforcement of the rule of law** and prevents misuse of power by the executive.
 
 
 
• **It maintains federal equilibrium**__
 __
 
• The Supreme Court has the authority to resolve disputes between **states and the central government**.
 
• This function maintains **federal balance** and prevents conflicts of jurisdiction.
 
 
 
• **It is the protector and guarantor of fundamental rights**__
 
 
• The Supreme Court ensures that the **fundamental rights** of citizens are not violated by the state or any other authority.
 
• It has the power to issue **writs** for the enforcement of these rights.

questions.question: All living organisms on the Earth are made up of carbon compounds. Many years ago, dead and buried plants started slowly modifying into coal under high temperature and high pressure. This process is called:

• **Carbonization** is the process by which **dead and buried plants** slowly transform into **coal**.
 
• This transformation occurs under conditions of **high temperature** and **high pressure**.
 
• The process involves the **chemical decomposition of organic materials** by heating them in the absence of air, leading to the formation of **carbon-rich substances**.
 
• **Coal** is primarily composed of carbon, hydrogen, sulfur, oxygen, and nitrogen.
 
• Coal is used as a **fossil fuel** for generating electricity, steel production, and as a liquid fuel.

• It is not related to the formation of coal but is a term used in the context of **petroleum**.
 
 
 
• **Peat formation**__
 __
 
• **Peat** is an accumulation of partially decayed vegetation or organic matter.
 
• It is the first stage in the formation of coal and is found in **wetland areas**.
 
• Peat can be used as a source of **fuel** and for **horticultural purposes**.
 
 
 
• **Composting**__
 
 
• **Composting** is the process of recycling organic waste into **fertilizer**.
 
• It involves the **decomposition** of organic matter by microorganisms in the presence of oxygen.

• Dividing 135 by 60 gives us the beat frequency: **135/60 = 2.25 Hz**.
 
• Therefore, the beat frequency of the heart is **2.25 Hz**.

 __
 
• This value is **incorrect** because it is not the result of dividing 135 by 60.
 
• A beat frequency of 1.12 Hz would correspond to a heart rate of **67.2 beats per minute**, which is much lower than 135 beats per minute.
 
 
 
• **135 Hz**__
